heading: 12. Example

## 12. Example [LOPQ.12]

A `crypto` adapter publishes `Key`, `Signature`, `Digest`; the build coordinator's
rules route on keys and delegate verification, and can neither read nor forge key
material:

`r.builder_pubkey.len()` ([LOPQ.3.3]), `r.builder_pubkey == r.artifact_hash`
(`Key` vs `Digest`, [LOPQ.2.3]), and `Key(some_bytes)` ([LOPQ.4.1]) are each
compile errors.
